definitions.explanation: An absorbent robe worn after bathing, typically made of toweling material. Mostly seen in hotels, spas, and Western-style home settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧バスローブ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A bathrobe had been provided in the hotel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風呂|ふろ}{上|あ}がり→風呂上がり：22451_furoagari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧バスローブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{羽織|はお}った→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a bathrobe after my bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧バスローブ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The bathrobes at high-end hotels are fluffy and feel wonderful.

notes:
Loanword from English "bathrobe." Not part of traditional Japanese bathing, which uses ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧ after bathing in ryokan and hot springs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バスローブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to put on a bathrobe
- バスローブ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{羽織|はお}る→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧: to throw on a bathrobe
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧バスローブ: luxury bathrobe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧: yukata — Japanese cotton kimono, worn after bathing at ryokan
- ガウン: gown — broader term, can include dressing gowns and academic gowns
- ⟦パジャマ→パジャマ：04516_pajama⟧: pajamas — for sleeping, not after bathing
